history_item.title: Grace Hopper builds the first compiler
history_item.description: Hopper's A-0 system (1952) was the first compiler, translating symbolic code into machine code and paving the way for high-level languages.

The teams that win won't be the ones that adopt the most tools, but the ones that keep their pipelines observable, their data governed, and their systems boring where it counts.
